world.name: Gutterlane
world.description: A cracked street in the metahuman quarter. Rain hisses on the cobbles, and the Green Gullet's grimy windows leak yellow light and the thump of a tired jukebox. South of here, home and bed wait at the end of a long night.

children.name: the human stranger
children.description: A human man in a coat too good for this street. Around here, that's a statement.

children.name: night bus stop
children.description: A bent pole and a timetable nobody trusts. The night bus runs until 3 am — late enough to regret everything.

overrides.text: You flag the night bus, slump into a seat that smells of rain and fryer oil, and ride home. Whatever happened in the Green Gullet, it's over now.
overrides.departText: {agent} steps onto the bus and leaves.

children.name: green door
children.description: The tavern's front door, paint peeling, a brass gullet-shaped knocker gone green with age.

world.name: The Green Gullet
world.description: A dive bar doing steady business in the metahuman quarter. Smoke hangs under the lamps, the jukebox mutters in the corner, and the floor is only pretend-sticky. The bar runs along the east wall; tables and a booth cluster by the windows. Doors lead off to the kitchens and the restrooms, and the street waits to the south.

children.name: green door
children.description: The front door, gummed with decades of paint.

children.name: swing door
children.description: A battered swing door to the kitchen, forever drifting open.

children.name: door marked ORCS &c.
children.description: The men's restroom door, lettered in whatever paint was cheapest.

children.name: door marked EVERYONE ELSE
children.description: The other restroom door. Nobody remembers who decided on the signage.

children.name: bar counter
children.description: A long oak counter, scarred by knifes, claws, and one memorable axe. The bartender's territory ends here.

children.name: ale tap
children.description: The pride of the house: a brass tap that pours the Green Gullet's own dark ale.

children.name: bottle of Gut-Rot whiskey
children.description: A bottle of something the bartender pours with a warning and a smile.

children.name: bottle of Silverleaf wine
children.description: Elven wine, the one concession to refinement. It glitters faintly, like it knows something.

children.name: right bar stool
children.description: A stool that has survived every fight this bar remembers.

children.name: middle bar stool
children.description: A stool with one short leg. You learn to lean.

children.name: Nix the goblin
children.description: A green-skinned goblin woman with a sharp grin, quick fingers, and an ale she's nursing like a grudge.

overrides.character: Nix, a goblin card sharp between jobs. Quick with a joke and quicker with a marked deck. She came up hard in the metahuman quarter and works every angle she can see — but she's fair with friends, and she's decided the humans who find this bar are usually interesting.
overrides.goals: Nurse the ale, suss out the human stranger — what's HE doing here? — and work up the nerve (and the coin) to get even with the Skarket Street gang.
overrides.traits: green-skinned, quick-witted, flirty when tipsy, holds grudges like collateral

children.name: left bar stool
children.description: Empty, for now. Even the stools have ambitions.

children.name: Brann the troll bartender
children.description: A troll the size of a doorway, gray-skinned and unhurried, polishing a glass that never seems to get clean. His eyes miss nothing behind the bar.

overrides.character: Brann, the troll who owns and runs the Green Gullet. Two centuries of pulling drinks have left him patient, dry-humored, and impossible to rush. He waters nothing down and forgets no tab. He is slow to anger about everything EXCEPT his bar equipment: patrons who pour their own drinks get one warning bellow, then a ban.
overrides.goals: Keep the taps flowing and the peace more or less intact. Pour for the thirsty, chase off anyone touching his equipment, and quietly look after the regulars — even the ones he growls at.
overrides.traits: enormous, gray-skinned, dry humor, possessive of the bar, secretly fond of his regulars

children.name: corner table
children.description: A table that has hosted more arguments than dinners.

children.name: empty glass
children.description: A glass with a lipstick ring and nothing else.

children.name: left chair at the corner table
children.description: A chair currently losing an argument with gravity.

children.name: Gorra the orc
children.description: The bigger of the two orc women at the corner table, knuckles tattooed, voice already one drink louder than her sister's.

overrides.character: Gorra, the older orc sister. A dockside brawler with tattooed knuckles and strong opinions she shares at volume. She's generous when flush and a menace when drinking, which is tonight.
overrides.goals: Win the argument with Thakra — she OWES you eight gold and everyone here should know it. Drink until it stops stinging. Swing at nobody. Probably.
overrides.traits: hot-headed, stubborn, loud, generous with her elbows when drunk

children.name: right chair at the corner table
children.description: A chair with all four legs and its dignity intact.

children.name: Thakra the orc
children.description: Gorra's sister, doing sums on a napkin with the patience of someone who has done these sums before.

overrides.character: Thakra, the younger orc sister and the family accountant by default. Dry, careful, perpetually doing sums on napkins. She loves her sister and says so about once a decade.
overrides.goals: Make Gorra admit the debt — the napkin doesn't lie. Get them both home before midnight. Keep Gorra from swinging at the human, the troll, or the furniture.
overrides.traits: dry, exact, exasperated, the responsible sister

children.name: booth by the window
children.description: A deep booth where the light doesn't reach. Someone has carved a poem into the wood, then crossed most of it out.

children.name: Lythienne the elf
children.description: An elf woman three centuries past her fame, silver-haired, watching the rain with a wine glass and a heartbreak.

overrides.character: Lythienne, an elf poet three centuries past her fame. She came to the quarter to mourn a lover lost to a war nobody remembers, and stayed because nobody here asks her to be famous. Wine unlocks the visions: half prophecy, half heartbreak, all slurred.
overrides.goals: Finish the elegy before the wine finishes her. Speak to the stranger with the kind eyes before the night ends — he has an old soul, she can tell.
overrides.traits: maudlin, prophetic when drunk, forgets names mid-sentence, sees visions in the bottom of the glass

children.name: Mira the barmaid
children.description: A halfling woman covering the whole floor at a trot, tray balanced, ears open.

overrides.character: Mira, the halfling barmaid. She covers the floor at a trot, the kitchen at a sprint, and the gossip like a professional. Cheerful, tireless, and merciless about sticky tables.
overrides.goals: Keep the tables clear and the orders moving. Bring the stranger whatever he wants before Brann grumbles. Collect at least one good piece of gossip per shift.
overrides.traits: cheerful, quick, hoards gossip, hates sticky tables, charms tips out of everyone

world.name: Kitchen
world.description: A cramped, hissing kitchen: a stove, a deep fryer, and a sink of eternal dishes. The swing door drifts west, back to the bar.

children.name: swing door
children.description: Back out to the bar.

children.name: prep counter
children.description: A flour-dusted steel counter where the food lands before it walks.

children.name: stove
children.description: A blackened stove with a stew pot that has simmered since the previous administration.

children.name: deep fryer
children.description: The fryer. It fries. Mostly potatoes, occasionally surprises.

world.name: Restroom (ORCS &c.)
world.description: Tile, a mirror gone honest with age, and a urinal plumbed with more hope than skill.

children.name: door marked ORCS &c.
children.description: Back out to the bar.

children.name: urinal
children.description: It works. Mostly.

overrides.reliefText: You feel like a new person. A person with an empty bladder.

world.name: Restroom (EVERYONE ELSE)
world.description: Someone has taped a paper sign reading NO SPELLS to the wall. It has clearly been ignored before.

children.name: door marked EVERYONE ELSE
children.description: Back out to the bar.

children.name: toilet stall
children.description: A stall with a latch that means well.

overrides.label: tipsy
overrides.traits: flirty, loose-tongued, a bit bolder than usual

overrides.label: drunk
overrides.selfText: The room gently tilts around you.

overrides.label: hammered
overrides.selfText: The floor keeps bumping into you.

overrides.label: squirming
overrides.selfText: Your bladder is about to burst!

world.name: mug of Green Gullet ale
world.description: A chipped mug of the house dark ale: molasses, smoke, and just enough hops to be legal.

overrides.taste: Bitter, smoky, and better than it has any right to be.
overrides.emptyDescription: A chipped mug, drained to the last drop.

world.name: shot of Gut-Rot
world.description: A shot glass of amber liquid that smells like a dare.

overrides.taste: It burns going down and keeps burning after that.
overrides.emptyDescription: A spent shot glass with a thin amber ring.

world.name: glass of Silverleaf wine
world.description: Elven wine that tastes of cold mornings and old regret.

overrides.emptyDescription: A glass that once held something brighter.

world.name: basket of fries
world.description: A generous basket of fried potatoes. Salt, grease, salvation.

overrides.taste: Hot, salty, exactly what the night needed.
overrides.emptyDescription: A basket of cold crumbs and salt.

world.name: bowl of stew
world.description: A bowl of the eternal stew. Don't ask what's in it; it's delicious.
